goal: Page one on Google for these ten searches during the 2026-27 season.
measurement: Rank is not measured here. This file checks that the page answers each search in crawlable text. Measure rank from a Search Console query export for /michigan-snow-totals/ (position and impressions per query), starting when snow is being reported. Demand evidence is the Sep 26 2026 Google autocomplete pull recorded in benchmarks/snow-totals-personas.json.
outOfScope: Snow depth and snow on the ground belong to national-snow (/national-tools/snow/) under the tool-network registry, so no depth query is targeted here.

targets.query: how much snow did michigan get yesterday
how much snow did michigan get
how much snow did marquette get this year
